newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares down at noon on a correction.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares down at noon on a correction.

text.p: Shanghai B shares were down at midday on Tuesday after several key companies posted poor 1996 results, brokers said.
The B share index fell 1.135 points or 1.25 percent to 89.535 points on volume of 12.618 million shares worth $8.63 million, compared with $8.462 million on Monday.
Eight B share companies posted 1996 results on Tuesday, most reporting falling profits.
Selling in companies with poor results dragged down the index today, but the downward potential will be limited with sentiment still good, brokers said.
Bicycle maker Shanghai Phoenix on Monday reported a loss of 93.52 million yuan for 1996 compared with a net profit of 25.37 million yuan for 1995 based on international accounting standards.
"Phoenix posting a loss triggered some profit-taking," said one broker.
"It is only a minor correction compared with yesterday's sharp gains," another broker said. "The index will rise again after the impact of the annual results has been absorbed."
Of 43 B shares, 32 traded, with 28 down, three flat and one down.
Shanghai Forever Bicycle was the biggest loser, slipping $0.012 or 5.08 percent to $0.224 on volume of 190,000 shares.
Shanghai Lujiazui Finance & Trade Zone Development was the most actively traded stock on profit-taking, down $0.022 or 1.49 percent to $1.450 on volume of 1.9 million shares.
Shanghai's A share index dipped on profit-taking ahead of the Labour Day holiday, brokers said.
The index shed 5.103 points or 0.36 percent to 1,406.822 points on volume of 334.8 million shares worth 4.7 billion yuan.
The SSE30 blue chip index fell 10.853 points or 0.28 percent to 3,893.642 points.
Haci was the biggest loser on profit-taking, plunging 3.12 yuan or 9.98 percent to 28.13 yuan on volume of 567,600 shares.
